facts.fact: ITWeb describes the Information Regulator as South Africa's data privacy enforcer issuing notices under POPIA.
ITWeb reports POPIA being enforced by fines, with penalties of up to R10 million and 10 years in jail provided for.

ITWeb reports the Information Regulator issued First National Bank an infringement notice and a R1 million fine under POPIA after 88 home loan applicants' data was exposed to 696 unauthorised individuals.
